data.body: **P2 — Stop emitting completion spans after ending their parents.** A fresh update arriving while the second `forceFlush()` awaits is still drained through `onOperationEnd`, although Invocation and terminal Workflow have already ended. In `InvocationOtelPlugin`, the resulting continuation starts after its parent's end; the execution view likewise overruns Workflow when the completion timestamp is later. This breaks temporal containment even without clock skew. Establish a completion cutoff and drain accepted updates before ending parents, then make the final pass provider-only and handle later notifications through recovery. Apply the ordering to both views and add a regression that blocks the second flush; the containment test currently blocks only the first.
